card: Adds an activechainonly query parameter to the REST headers endpoint to allow querying single block headers from stale branches when set to false with count=1. Currently, /rest/headers returns empty arrays for any block not on the active chain, leaving REST clients unable to trace ancestor headers during reorgs without JSON-RPC. The author notes this brings parity with the getblockheader RPC and resolves issue #35897. The change also deduplicates boolean query parameter parsing across the REST interface.
evidence: Resolves issue #35897 ('rest: Allow fetching headers from stale branches').

Author states that 'Being able to request stale block headers is useful for clients that want to learn the ancestors of a blockhash e.g. when following a re-org up and matches the functionality of the getblockheader RPC.'
problem: Currently, the /rest/headers/ endpoint only returns block headers that are part of the active chain, returning an empty list for stale blocks. Clients relying on the REST interface cannot inspect stale block headers or trace ancestor headers during a chain reorganization without falling back to the getblockheader RPC.
summary: Adds an optional activechainonly boolean query parameter to the /rest/headers/ endpoint to allow fetching headers not on the active chain. When activechainonly is set to false and count is 1, the endpoint returns the header even if it belongs to a stale branch. The PR also extracts REST boolean query parameter parsing into a shared helper function used by headers and mempool endpoints.
